integrity: Direct finite-field checker independently enumerates all matrices only for the stated small examples; general statements are supported by algebraic proofs, not exhaustive computation. No independent external mathematical audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Counts ordered pairwise-commuting idempotent tuples of finite-poset incidence algebras; excludes arbitrary commuting matrices, non-idempotents and non-poset structural matrix algebras. Uses ordinary matrix ranks. Intrinsic simultaneous diagonalization and the single-idempotent orbit theorem are established prior results. The novelty assessment of the joint affine coordinates and exact multivariate finite-field enumerator is provisional pending independent bibliographic review.
title: Joint-rank and Potts enumerators for commuting incidence-algebra idempotents
